fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 22 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at 99.3 indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 22 days create binary event risk; macro environment is severely unfavourable for ABT.
